interactiveObjects.name: Guild Practice Lockbox
interactiveObjects.description: A battered iron box chained to the Guildhall porch. Applicants practise on it; it has seen things.

transcript.speaker: The Guildhall
transcript.text: The lockbox pops open. Inside: five drachmae and a note in Odile's hand: 'Well done. Put the cake back.' You do not put the cake back.

interactiveObjects.name: Guild Strongbox
interactiveObjects.description: The Guild's real money, behind the counter. Odile is right there. So is the Watch.

trap.name: Dye Bomb
trap.description: A glass vial of blue dye wired to the lid.

failureConsequence.message: Your pick skids with a screech that turns every head in the Guildhall.

transcript.speaker: The Guildhall
transcript.text: The strongbox clicks open. Nobody saw. Probably.

interactiveObjects.name: Beached Rowboat
interactiveObjects.unpickableReason: It is a boat stuck in shingle. There is no lock, only a lot of wet gravel.
interactiveObjects.description: A sturdy rowboat dragged far up the shingle and left to rot. Push it back into the water and Gull Rock is an hour's row away.

transcript.speaker: Saltreed Cove
transcript.text: With a grinding heave you shove the boat into the surf. It floats. Mostly. Gull Rock is in reach.

interactiveObjects.name: Stack of 'Fish' Crates
interactiveObjects.description: Padlocked crates stencilled FISH. They clink.

trap.name: Spring Needle
trap.description: A needle on a spring inside the padlock hasp.

failureConsequence.message: The padlock clangs against the crate. Across the beach, Jory looks up.

transcript.speaker: Saltreed Cove
transcript.text: The padlock gives. Brandy, a pearl, and a fine grey cloak packed in straw.

interactiveObjects.name: Lighthouse Door
interactiveObjects.description: An iron-bound door swollen with salt. Behind it, the bell tolls.

failureConsequence.message: Salt has jammed the tumblers. Your pick bends.

transcript.speaker: Gull Rock
transcript.text: The door grinds open on a spiral stair slick with seawater. The bell stops. Something wet starts climbing up.

interactiveObjects.name: Tide Warden's Reliquary
interactiveObjects.description: A barnacled stone chest on the altar steps, its lid carved with a lighthouse.

trap.name: Brine Jet
trap.description: A pressurised jet of stinging brine behind the lock.

transcript.speaker: The Sunken Chapel
transcript.text: Inside the reliquary: a silver censer and a long bronze key with a lighthouse on its bow. The chapel kept a spare.
